record.title: Combine independent capture and filesystem results for the next stock decision
record.intent: Require both observation fidelity and a reproducible filesystem fixture before stock validation.
requirements: Evaluate both independent results and their full health evidence; do not promote an unexecuted case or missing final sample into success.
If both are supported freeze and admit a bounded stock first-three-loader experiment and evaluation; otherwise admit only the specific unresolved observer or filesystem question.
Draft plan inspect admit and commit successor tasking before execution while preserving byte-identical stock artifacts and the no-physical-instrument boundary.
acceptance: Commit and push a supported decision and any bounded successor.
